programme.title: E2 - Northern Territory
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: E5 - Texas - Nilgai
programme.desc: Mike heads to Texas USA to stalk Nilgai in the wild - Mike cooks warm salsa with Rancher Leroy and grills Chops

programme.title: E8 - Indonesia
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish explore Indonesia in a fiery way. The duo test out their manhoods with leech therapy, wall jumping, participating in a traditional whip dance, and trying the ancient martial art of debus. They then slow down for a moment to stop and smell the Indonesian fruit durian and cut one out of a tree to taste test. Finally their Indonesian adventure ends with a game of flaming soccer in the streets and sulfur mining in the mouth of a volcano. With all of these wild and dangerous activities, can Rooftop and Catfish handle the heat of Indonesia?

programme.title: E1 - South Australia
programme.desc: In the first part of the episode, Andy explores sustainable kingfish farming in Spencer Gulf, South Australia, visiting Clean Seas sea farm and preparing fresh kingfish sashimi with the team. Moving to Kangaroo Island, he learns pickling techniques with Kate from Kangaroo Island Source, showcasing her products in a Carne Asada Taco. The episode continues with Andy exploring d'Arenberg's multi-function building and 'The Cube,' experiencing a Chef's Table, and concludes at Wirra Wirra winery, where he cooks Yogurt Flatbread with Olive Oil and Dukka, enjoying it with the staff and their wines.

programme.title: E5 - Volcanic Kingfish / Kingfish
programme.desc: Mario hooks up with old friend and current world record holder for kingfish Rick Pollock . They fish the the coast of Newzealand just off a live Volcano, then tragedy strikes…… after the Volcano erupts mario returns to catch a whopping Bass Grouper and prepares an amazing ceviche dish.

programme.title: E7 - Pigs and Saratoga
programme.desc: Mario returns to his home land in Australia to help a friend with some wild boar pest control and catch some prehistoric fish out of a billabong…. But drama strikes and Mario finds him self in crocodile infested water plucking fish out with his bare hands…. All of these delicious bush treats are prepared of course in a termite oven which Mario makes.

programme.title: E8 - Birds Of A Feather / Duck and Pheasant
programme.desc: Mario must face his fear as he harvests crayfish and abolone during the mating season of the great white sharks. He then heads up into chamois territory in mountain tops of Fiordland. This world heritage area is where the mountains meet the sea, it’s very remote and rugged and the perfect setting for a New Zealand inspired surf and turf dish.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, new comer Storm is along for the ride. Despite being 16 he is determined to make his mark as a valued member of the crew. Dwane’s friend and fellow diver, Tim, joins the team as they embark on a first collecting a slimy alternative to urchin. Plus Dwane is forced to make an executive decision when faced by a boisterous seven gill shark.

programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles?

programme.title: A Taxi Driver
programme.desc: May 1980. A Seoul taxi driver named Man-seob comes across an offer too good to be true. If he drives a foreign passenger from Seoul down to Gwangju and back again before the curfew, he'll be paid the unthinkable sum of 100,000 won – enough to cover several months of unpaid rent. Without stopping to ask the details, he picks up the German reporter Peter and sets off along the highway. Although stopped by police roadblocks at the edge of Gwangju, Man-seob is desperate to earn his taxi fare, and eventually manages to find a way into the city. There they encounter students and ordinary citizens taking part in large-scale demonstrations against the government. Man-seob, alarmed by the danger in the air, pleads with Peter to go quickly back to Seoul. But Peter ignores him...

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: 講述柔道選手出身的女主角溫心（金世正飾），因傷被迫放棄當運動員，轉職網絡漫畫編輯，揭開人生新一頁的同時，亦反映韓國網絡漫畫業界激烈競爭的情况。​

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 擁有雙重面貌卻守節十五年的蒙面寡婦，在白天是個足不出戶、行為謹慎的女人。到了晚上，她就會翻牆出去，戴著面紗去照顧那些有需要的人。在某天晚上卻遇到了追查年幼時慘死的父親死因的男人。這使她開始對未來有所憧憬。但當他們一起捲入一場意想不到的事件時，生活發生了巨大的變化。

programme.title: E13
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E3 - 在世界上海拔最高的國門升旗
programme.desc: 孟非、劉震雲決心效仿中國最早的自由行「西遊」，攜何廣智、李雅娟升級為「非震式旅行社」；邀請尹正、哈妮克孜、武藝、張雨綺、楊迪、楊超越等飛行嘉賓，先後到達喀什，塔什庫爾干，獨庫公路，烏茲別克斯坦等地，串聯起雪山草原、戈壁大漠、城市綠洲，開啟一場前所未有的奇遇之旅。

programme.title: E34 - 誠意滿滿 送上專屬告白
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: E4 - 冉瑩穎鄒市明雙向告白
programme.desc: 以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案。

programme.title: E1 - 高瀚宇周震南抬價上頭被反殺
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到。

programme.title: The Yuppie Fantasia
programme.desc: Leung Foon is one of those youthful, upward-moving people. He is 33, middle rung officer of an advertising agency, and has been married eight years to Ann. Ann holds down a key post in a finance company. She also likes to manage Foon's life. The couple has been drifting apart. A quarrel and the two decide to separate. Q-Taro and Big Cheat, Foon's colleagues and close friends, like to fool around. Q is married to the city shrew while Big Cheat's wife puts him above everything else. Foon has a new boss, Mrs. Lam who wants to rid the agency of useless employees. She forces Foon to fire Q-Taro...

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Yan always sees dead people. Jim, her psychologist, thinks it's all in her mind brought by loneliness and by unpleasant experiences of past relationships. He devotes all his time to curing her. Jim soon falls in love as Yan is freed of her vision. But then he starts seeing dead people too. Jim remembers his past. His girlfriend in high school, named Yu, committed suicide when Jim tried to break up with her in twenty years ago. Now, with Yan's help and love, can Jim face up to the ghost and end the nightmare?
